name: Moonreef Sovereign Throne
introDiscord: At Moonlit Reef's farthest boundary, the Astral Tide and Lunar Current meet beneath a royal reef of towering coral. Old Moonkeeper banners drift above monumental roads leading toward a crown-shaped silhouette.
introTwitch: At Moonlit Reef's farthest boundary, the Astral Tide and Lunar Current meet beneath a royal reef of towering coral. Old Moonkeeper banners drift above monumental roads leading toward a crown-shaped silhouette.

sovereign-approach.prompt: The royal approach begins beneath towering coral arches where the Astral Tide and Lunar Current braid together. Three monumental roads climb toward the distant throne.

left.message: Shizuki's best restorative waits beneath a marker: "Saved this for whoever made it this far. Yes, that includes me. Past me was very thoughtful."
left.fullHpMessage: Preserve full-HP behavior with Adventure-specific wording consistent with the above.

right.message: A Moonkeeper cache rests beneath the first royal arch. Unlike nearly every other cache you've encountered, nothing has stolen, moved, chewed, reflected, hidden, or insulted it. Suspicious. Inside are Star Candies.

forward.message: A Moonreef Sovereign descends from the monumental coral above, its armor reflecting both currents at once. This guardian clearly takes the royal approach seriously.

crownreef-processional.prompt: Shattered Moonkeeper standards line a long processional toward the throne. Ancient guardian figures stand beneath them while three routes cross the royal reef.

left.message: A Sovereign blocks the processional with ceremonial precision. No tricks. No ambush. It simply points its weapon at the exit behind it. Refreshingly straightforward.

right.message: Shizuki's note reads: "No throne grants freedom. Walking away does. Also drink this because walking away is easier when not bleeding."
right.fullHpMessage: Shizuki's freedom-minded restorative remains unused. You are already at full health and ready to keep walking away on your own terms.

forward.message: A moon-shell coffer sits beneath one broken standard. Opening it releases Star Candies and a tiny puff of ceremonial glitter. The ancient Moonkeepers had style.

last-moonkeeper-way.prompt: The last path climbs through silent starlight toward three gates beneath the throne. Behind you, Moonlit Reef stretches across every place you have traveled.

left.message: A Fae vessel rests beside the final gate containing Star Candies. Someone has tied a tiny ribbon around it. No trap. No joke. Just a gift for reaching the end.

right.message: The final Sovereign stands before the throne chamber. It bows once before raising its weapon.

forward.message:
One final Berry rests beneath Shizuki's carving:

"I survived.

I wandered.

I got VERY lost.

Then I chose what came next.

Your turn."

boss-antechamber.name: Throne of the First Tide
boss-antechamber.prompt: Use an appropriately majestic room prompt describing the Throne itself while preserving the existing chamber identity.

bossPromptDiscord:
The Astral Tide slows.

The Lunar Current stills.

Above the throne, ancient moonlight gathers into the shape of a vast crown while every surviving Sovereign kneels along the processional.

The heart of Moonlit Reef is waking.

Use /yes to approach the Throne of the First Tide or /no to return when you are ready.
bossPromptTwitch:
The Astral Tide slows.

The Lunar Current stills.

Above the throne, ancient moonlight gathers into the shape of a vast crown while every surviving Sovereign kneels along the processional.

The heart of Moonlit Reef is waking.

Use !yes to approach the Throne of the First Tide or !no to return when you are ready.
bossRetreatText: You step back from the Throne of the First Tide. The gathered crown of moonlight dims, and the kneeling Sovereigns remain perfectly still.

boss.revealText: Lunar radiance pours from the throne and takes shape around an ancient guardian. The Crown of the Moonreef rises!

completionText:
The Crown of the Moonreef dissolves into soft lunar radiance.

For a moment, the Throne of the First Tide is peaceful.

Then something beneath it answers.

Stone shifts.

Artificial moonlight leaks through a seam that absolutely does not belong in the ancient reef.

A hidden human passage opens beneath the throne.

Adventure 30 — Moonlit Lab is unlocked.
